title: Postdoctoral Fellowships at HUJI

compensation.value: NIS 7,128 per month (subject to annual updates), plus housing allowance of NIS 600 (single) or NIS 1,000 (with family) per month
compensation.evidence_quote: NIS 7,128 per month (subject to annual updates)

about: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem invites applications for 12-month postdoctoral fellowships for 2027-2028, starting October 2027, open across a wide range of disciplines. The stipend is NIS 7,128 per month plus a housing allowance. Renewal requires a new application.
requirements: For new postdoctoral fellows only; current active HUJI postdoctoral fellows are not eligible
Further rules in the university's postdoctoral regulations
